candidates.change_summary: Return the zero address instead of the stored owner (changes visible return of owner()).
Removed the require that newOwner is not the zero address, allowing transferOwnership(address(0)) to succeed.
Added a restriction that only the current owner can set a non-zero newOwner; if caller is not owner, newOwner must be zero, changing allowed transfer targets.
Inverted the onlyOwner check to require the caller is NOT the owner, changing which callers can invoke owner-only functions like transferOwnership.
Return a hardcoded different string constant instead of the _name storage variable.
Change ERC20.symbol() to return a hardcoded different string constant instead of the _symbol state variable.
